text:
jamal: CI red on PR #776 — integration matrix job python-3.9 failed on TestCacheEviction. Looks intermittent. Can someone kick a light retry that preserves the docker/image cache? Don’t want a full image rebuild.

alex_m: You can use the internal retry helper to target the matrix slice and keep cache: 
```
/ci retry --pr 776 --job integration --matrix python-3.9 --preserve-image-cache
```
(This hits our orchestration that avoids image rebuild if the previous image push completed.)

alex_m: If you prefer GH comments triggering the bot: 
```
gh pr comment 776 --body "/retest integration --matrix=python-3.9 --preserve-cache"
```

ci-bot: queued rerun for PR 776 — job: integration (python-3.9). preserving image cache flag honored when previous run completed image build step. run id: 4589.

sarah: Thanks — I’ll kick that now and also try reproducing the test locally. Quick local run I use: 
```
TOXENV=py39 tox -e py39 -- tests/test_cache.py::TestCacheEviction -k "test_eviction"
```

jamal: If it fails again, please bisect to narrow the commit: 
```
ci bisect --pr 776 --job integration --shard 3 --start=main~10 --end=HEAD
```

infra-automation: small gotcha: --preserve-image-cache only avoids image rebuild if the previous job reached the "push-image" step. If the prior failure occurred before that step, the runner will rebuild. Check the job logs for "build-image step succeeded" before assuming preserved cache.

alex_m: Also ask for the failing test output (copy paste) — sometimes it’s a transient network/io timeout, bumping timeout helps to confirm flakiness (e.g., increase from 120s -> 300s temporarily).

sarah: posted the failing snippet to the PR comment (link: https://redwood.internal/paste/abcd1234) — looks like an occasional socket timeout. I’ll re-run and update. :thumbsup:

jamal: great — thanks. Tag me if the light retry still shows red and we can escalate to a full rebuild or run a full matrix bisect.

sarah: rerun finished: green ✅ (kept cache). marking flaky and adding a follow-up ticket to track flaky TestCacheEviction.

jamal: perfect, closing the loop — thanks everyone.
